Load source data

Source: R/load.R
load_source_data.Rd

Reads the source data file, exactly as MixSIAR::load_source_data() does, with the same arguments: either source summary statistics (data_type = "means") or raw source samples (data_type = "raw"), which are summarised to means, SDs and sample sizes.

Usage

load_source_data(filename, source_factors = NULL, conc_dep, data_type, mix)

Arguments

filename

Path of the source .csv file (or a data frame): source names in the first column, then Mean<tracer>, SD<tracer>, n and, with concentration dependence, Conc<tracer>.

source_factors

Name of the categorical effect the sources are given by (one row per source and level), or NULL.

conc_dep

Logical: use concentration dependence?

data_type

"means" (source means, SDs and sample sizes) or "raw" (one row per source sample, columns named by the tracers). Raw data are summarised to each source's mean, SD and sample size (per level of source_factors, if given; with mean concentrations if conc_dep), which is what the networks use. MixSIAR's raw data model instead estimates each source's mean and variance in the fit, so results can differ a little from MixSIAR's for small source samples.

mix

The output of load_mix_data().

Value

A list with data, source_names (MixSIAR's alphabetical order), n.sources, source_factors, by_factor, conc_dep, conc, data_type, S_factor1 and S_factor_levels.
